items.name: Guild Dispatch
items.description: An urgent commission signed by Archivist Mara Venn. The abandoned observatory has begun transmitting an obsolete distress signal bearing the cipher of Dr. Elian Rook, who vanished there thirty-two years ago. You are to identify the source before tonight's conjunction and determine whether the signal is a warning.

items.name: Brass Key
items.description: A heavy brass key engraved with the observatory's seven-star seal. One tooth is darkened by years of contact with an oiled lock.

items.name: Caretaker's Journal
items.description: The final page is written in a hurried hand: "Rook says the signal is an answer. He will not shut the telescope down. I removed the focusing lens and locked it in the chart room. If the beacon wakes again, do not let it finish the observation."

items.name: Telescope Lens
items.description: A heavy glass lens held in a brass frame. Its surface remains unnaturally cold, and the engraved constellations around its edge do not match the modern sky.

items.name: Rook's Observation Log
items.description: Dr. Rook's calculations track an absence rather than a star: a moving region where every instrument records less light than empty space should contain. His final entry reads, "Tonight it looked back."
